name: growth-marketer
description: Marketing automation for mobile apps and web/SaaS — ICP+VOC analysis, channel scoring + playbooks, cognitive-psychology copy, CRO audit, consistency QA, and ad-platform draft entry (publishing remains a human step). Claude-in-Chrome MCP powered.

interface.shortDescription: End-to-end marketing automation: analyze service, recommend channels, write copy, audit CRO, QA, and draft ad campaigns.
interface.longDescription: growth-marketer chains six skills covering the full marketing loop. analyze-service reads your App Store listing or landing page via Claude-in-Chrome, or a local codebase directory (README/manifest/docs), to extract ICP, VOC quotes, positioning, and channel signals; an optional DataForSEO HTTP enrichment adds real search volume and Google/Naver SERP competitors (credentials via 1Password, gracefully skipped if absent). channel-playbook tailors per-channel operating playbooks (targeting, bidding, creative specs, KPIs) from baked references. generate-copy produces ads/CTAs, landing copy, email sequences, and organic social with each variant annotated by cognitive-psychology technique id and source; dark-pattern techniques are explicitly out of scope. cro-audit reads conversion funnels read-only and grades friction against baked CRO best practices with prioritized fixes. review-assets QAs the whole artifact set for brand voice, claim/evidence integrity, and dark-pattern risk, emitting a review-checklist whose gate_status is a hard publish gate. draft-campaign uses Claude-in-Chrome to enter ad-platform fields as a DRAFT ONLY — the schema and tests forbid a published state, and review-checklist=pass plus screenshot read-back are required. All outputs are saved as structured artifacts under .growth-marketer/<slug>/ and validated against per-skill data-contract schemas via a generic validate-artifact.sh.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my app and recommend marketing channels.
Build a Meta Ads playbook for my SaaS.
Write landing-page copy using loss aversion and social proof.
Audit my signup funnel for conversion friction.
QA all my marketing assets for brand voice and dark-pattern risk.
Draft a Google Ads campaign from my approved copy (do not publish).
